requirement: a pre-specified endpoint, effect size and population defining what counts as 'the solution'
evidence: the repository reports LVEF gains, CRP values and hazard ratios, but has never pre-specified which of these, at what threshold, in whom, would constitute success
if_failed: without a definition, any result can be narrated as success after the fact; this is the single most important missing item

requirement: the model can rank the candidate mechanisms it is asked to choose between
evidence: four downstream mechanisms differ by 0.000252 mg/L; separating them needs 66,093,675,293 patients per arm
if_failed: the simulation cannot select what to test; it can only exclude what is structurally impossible

requirement: the model distinguishes the interventions it claims to compare
evidence: LDL lowering and NF-kB inhibition are the same perturbation to machine precision (max difference 0.0e+00)
if_failed: any 'LDL drug versus anti-inflammatory drug' comparison in this model is a parameter compared with itself

requirement: the fitted parameters are determined by the data rather than chosen
evidence: 0 of 14 cytokine rates are jointly identifiable; 32 of 92 registered parameters are hypothetical
if_failed: a laboratory would be testing the modeller's assumptions, not the hypothesis; a negative result would be uninterpretable

requirement: the model predicts data it was not built from
evidence: 0 of 7 validation targets are present in data/
if_failed: the repository sits at CONVERGENCE and cannot claim predictive validity; a converged wrong answer is still wrong

requirement: each prediction carries a number that would show it to be false
evidence: every current test asserts the code does what it was written to do; none asserts a quantity that external data could contradict
if_failed: no laboratory outcome can refute the model, so any result would be absorbed as consistent

requirement: the output carries an interval that includes parameter uncertainty
evidence: the interval reported is over seeds and scenarios; it does not include uncertainty in the 32 hypothetical parameters, because they have no distribution to propagate
if_failed: the reported interval is narrower than the true one, and its width is a property of the sampler rather than of the evidence

requirement: the transfer has a stated comparator, not just an intervention
evidence: REVIVED's guideline-therapy arm moves LVEF by +3.4 pp on its own; the architecture has never been compared against it in this repository
if_failed: a laboratory or trial reading of the result cannot separate the intervention from the background therapy everyone receives anyway
